key: If carrying cereal disease over worries you, swap it for broad beans by hand.
english: If carrying cereal disease over worries you, swap it for broad beans by hand.
draft: As jy bekommerd is dat graansiektes oorgedra word, ruil dit self vir boerbone om.

key: Your farmer-observed frost months ({months}) were used: frost-sensitive crops are not suggested when their field growing period crosses those months.
english: Your farmer-observed frost months ({months}) were used: frost-sensitive crops are not suggested when their field growing period crosses those months.
draft: Jou ryp-maande soos deur die boer waargeneem ({months}) is gebruik: rypgevoelige gewasse word nie voorgestel wanneer hul veldgroeitydperk oor daardie maande strek nie.

key: Unrecorded months are not a promise of frost-free conditions.
english: Unrecorded months are not a promise of frost-free conditions.
draft: Maande wat nie aangeteken is nie, is nie 'n belofte van rypvrye toestande nie.

key: Yield benchmarks are used only where the catalog has them; missing kilograms are never invented.
english: Yield benchmarks are used only where the catalog has them; missing kilograms are never invented.
draft: Opbrengsmaatstawwe word slegs gebruik waar die katalogus dit het; ontbrekende kilogram word nooit uitgedink nie.

key: Frost-free sowing months for {names} are not yet from a published local table — check those dates with your extension officer before relying on them.
english: Frost-free sowing months for {names} are not yet from a published local table — check those dates with your extension officer before relying on them.
draft: Rypvrye saaimaande vir {names} kom nog nie uit 'n gepubliseerde plaaslike tabel nie — kontroleer daardie datums met jou voorligtingsbeampte voordat jy daarop staatmaak.

key: {names} was left out: no sowing window remains after checking your observed frost months ({months}) and the available site climate.
english: {names} was left out: no sowing window remains after checking your observed frost months ({months}) and the available site climate.
draft: {names} is weggelaat: geen saaivenster bly oor nadat jou waargenome ryp-maande ({months}) en die beskikbare terreinklimaat nagegaan is nie.

key: {names} were left out: no sowing window remains after checking your observed frost months ({months}) and the available site climate.
english: {names} were left out: no sowing window remains after checking your observed frost months ({months}) and the available site climate.
draft: {names} is weggelaat: geen saaivenster bly oor nadat jou waargenome ryp-maande ({months}) en die beskikbare terreinklimaat nagegaan is nie.

key: Check a protected growing area or local timing with your extension officer before adding frost-sensitive crops by hand.
english: Check a protected growing area or local timing with your extension officer before adding frost-sensitive crops by hand.
draft: Kontroleer 'n beskutte groeigebied of plaaslike tydsberekening met jou voorligtingsbeampte voordat jy self rypgevoelige gewasse byvoeg.

key: the field period crosses your observed frost months
english: the field period crosses your observed frost months
draft: die veldtydperk strek oor jou waargenome ryp-maande

key: the field period crosses your observed frost months, or another site heat or rainfall check rules it out
english: the field period crosses your observed frost months, or another site heat or rainfall check rules it out
draft: die veldtydperk strek oor jou waargenome ryp-maande, of 'n ander hitte- of reënvaltoets vir die terrein sluit dit uit

key: . The mild, dry winter suits cool-season crops; the warm, frost-free conditions also carry
english: . The mild, dry winter suits cool-season crops; the warm, frost-free conditions also carry
draft: . Die sagte, droë winter pas koelseisoengewasse; die warm, rypvrye toestande dra ook

key: . The warm, frost-free conditions also carry
english: . The warm, frost-free conditions also carry
draft: . Die warm, rypvrye toestande dra ook

key: thrive. Mild winters keep frost-tender crops viable on protected aspects.
english: thrive. Mild winters keep frost-tender crops viable on protected aspects.
draft: gedy. Sagte winters hou rypgevoelige gewasse lewensvatbaar op beskutte hellings.

key: . High humidity — select disease-resistant varieties and maximise airflow.
english: . High humidity — select disease-resistant varieties and maximise airflow.
draft: . Hoë humiditeit — kies siekteweerbare variëteite en sorg vir soveel lugvloei as moontlik.

key: on warm north-facing aspects. Protect all crops from frost and strong wind.
english: on warm north-facing aspects. Protect all crops from frost and strong wind.
draft: op warm noordhellings. Beskerm alle gewasse teen ryp en sterk wind.

key: This reading did not record where its numbers came from. Treat it with the same caution as a model estimate.
english: This reading did not record where its numbers came from. Treat it with the same caution as a model estimate.
draft: Hierdie meting het nie aangeteken waar sy syfers vandaan kom nie. Behandel dit met dieselfde versigtigheid as 'n modelskatting.

key: NOT A READING. No soil data was available for this point, so these are the app's general figures — the same numbers it would show anywhere. Do not spend money on the strength of them. A soil test is the only way to know.
english: NOT A READING. No soil data was available for this point, so these are the app's general figures — the same numbers it would show anywhere. Do not spend money on the strength of them. A soil test is the only way to know.
draft: NIE 'N METING NIE. Geen gronddata was vir hierdie punt beskikbaar nie, so dit is die app se algemene syfers — dieselfde getalle wat dit oral sou wys. Moenie geld op grond daarvan spandeer nie. 'n Grondtoets is die enigste manier om te weet.

key: Farmers who choose to be visible show up here as an approximate area — never their exact homestead.
english: Farmers who choose to be visible show up here as an approximate area — never their exact homestead.
draft: Boere wat kies om sigbaar te wees, verskyn hier as 'n benaderde gebied — nooit hul presiese opstal nie.

key: Repeat attendance counts as another attendance, not another person. Attendance and satisfaction are delivery evidence; they do not alone establish skills gained or impact.
english: Repeat attendance counts as another attendance, not another person. Attendance and satisfaction are delivery evidence; they do not alone establish skills gained or impact.
draft: Herhaalde bywoning tel as nog 'n bywoning, nie nog 'n persoon nie. Bywoning en tevredenheid is bewyse van lewering; hulle bewys nie op hul eie verworwe vaardighede of impak nie.

key: This is a sum of each garden’s latest recorded observation, not necessarily an area planted on one common date. Recheck at each reporting period. Organisation-checked does not mean independently audited. Crop cycles and multiple farmers do not add extra hectares.
english: This is a sum of each garden’s latest recorded observation, not necessarily an area planted on one common date. Recheck at each reporting period. Organisation-checked does not mean independently audited. Crop cycles and multiple farmers do not add extra hectares.
draft: Dit is 'n som van elke tuin se nuutste aangetekende waarneming, nie noodwendig 'n gebied wat op een gemeenskaplike datum geplant is nie. Kontroleer weer by elke verslagtydperk. Deur die organisasie nagegaan beteken nie onafhanklik geouditeer nie. Gewassiklusse en veelvuldige boere voeg nie ekstra hektaar by nie.

key: I checked that these areas do not overlap and this garden is not registered under another code.
english: I checked that these areas do not overlap and this garden is not registered under another code.
draft: Ek het nagegaan dat hierdie gebiede nie oorvleuel nie en dat hierdie tuin nie onder 'n ander kode geregistreer is nie.

key: Grain maize for mielie meal. Direct-sow in a mapped staple plot once frost risk has passed; use several adjacent rows for wind pollination. The 140-day calendar hold is conservative — confirm cultivar maturity before harvest.
english: Grain maize for mielie meal. Direct-sow in a mapped staple plot once frost risk has passed; use several adjacent rows for wind pollination. The 140-day calendar hold is conservative — confirm cultivar maturity before harvest.
draft: Graanmielies vir mieliemeel. Saai direk in 'n gekarteerde stapelvoedselperseel sodra die rypgevaar verby is; gebruik verskeie aangrensende rye vir windbestuiwing. Die 140 dae wat in die kalender gereserveer word, is konserwatief — bevestig die kultivar se rypwordingstyd voor die oes.

key: Plant after frost danger: November to mid-January in frost areas, or March-April in frost-free areas. Leave pods to yellow and dry before shelling and storing.
english: Plant after frost danger: November to mid-January in frost areas, or March-April in frost-free areas. Leave pods to yellow and dry before shelling and storing.
draft: Plant ná die rypgevaar: November tot middel-Januarie in rypgebiede, of Maart-April in rypvrye gebiede. Laat peule geel word en droog voordat jy dit uitdop en bêre.

key: Cut-and-come-again leafy brassica: pick outer leaves and the plant keeps producing, and light frost sweetens the flavour. It does not handle extreme heat — in hot areas prefer late-summer and autumn sowings. No South African kale yield has ever been published, so the kilogram estimate here comes from Kenyan and United States extension figures trimmed for a hand-watered bed — treat it as a planning slot, not a promise.
english: Cut-and-come-again leafy brassica: pick outer leaves and the plant keeps producing, and light frost sweetens the flavour. It does not handle extreme heat — in hot areas prefer late-summer and autumn sowings. No South African kale yield has ever been published, so the kilogram estimate here comes from Kenyan and United States extension figures trimmed for a hand-watered bed — treat it as a planning slot, not a promise.
draft: Sny-en-kom-weer-blaarkoolgewas: pluk die buitenste blare en die plant hou aan met produseer, en ligte ryp maak die smaak soeter. Dit hanteer nie uiterste hitte nie — in warm gebiede is laatsomer- en herfssaaie beter. Geen Suid-Afrikaanse opbrengs vir boerkool is nog ooit gepubliseer nie, so die kilogramskatting hier kom uit Keniaanse en Amerikaanse voorligtingsyfers, verminder vir 'n bedding wat met die hand natgemaak word — beskou dit as 'n plek in die beplanning, nie 'n belofte nie.

key: Direct-sow only — carrots don't transplant well. Keep the bed loose and stone-free.
english: Direct-sow only — carrots don't transplant well. Keep the bed loose and stone-free.
draft: Saai slegs direk — wortels plant nie goed oor nie. Hou die bedding los en klipvry.

key: Grown from rooted slips, not seed — plant into ridged soil for easy digging later.
english: Grown from rooted slips, not seed — plant into ridged soil for easy digging later.
draft: Word uit gewortelde steggies gekweek, nie uit saad nie — plant in grond met ruggies sodat dit later maklik uitgegrawe kan word.

key: Propagate from whole tubers or corm cuttings. Needs consistently moist soil and warm, frost-free conditions.
english: Propagate from whole tubers or corm cuttings. Needs consistently moist soil and warm, frost-free conditions.
draft: Vermeerder uit hele knolle of stukke van knolle. Het deurgaans klam grond en warm, rypvrye toestande nodig.

key: This stand is the audited irrigated geometry. Groundnuts need sandy, well-drained soil and a long frost-free growing season.
english: This stand is the audited irrigated geometry. Groundnuts need sandy, well-drained soil and a long frost-free growing season.
draft: Hierdie plantestand is die geouditeerde besproeide uitleg. Grondboontjies het sanderige, goed gedreineerde grond en 'n lang rypvrye groeiseisoen nodig.

key: The classic 'grows through winter' legume — sow in autumn, it stands through frost and pods in spring.
english: The classic 'grows through winter' legume — sow in autumn, it stands through frost and pods in spring.
draft: Die klassieke peulgewas wat 'deur die winter groei' — saai in die herfs, dit staan deur ryp en maak peule in die lente.

key: Real spinach (Spinacia oleracea) — not the Swiss chard South Africans usually call spinach. Cool-season and fast: it bolts in heat, so keep to the cool sowing windows and pick promptly. Same botanical family (Amaranthaceae) as Swiss chard and beetroot, so the rotation rule treats all three as one family — do not follow one with another in the same bed.
english: Real spinach (Spinacia oleracea) — not the Swiss chard South Africans usually call spinach. Cool-season and fast: it bolts in heat, so keep to the cool sowing windows and pick promptly. Same botanical family (Amaranthaceae) as Swiss chard and beetroot, so the rotation rule treats all three as one family — do not follow one with another in the same bed.
draft: Regte spinasie (Spinacia oleracea) — nie die snybeet wat Suid-Afrikaners gewoonlik spinasie noem nie. Koelseisoen en vinnig: dit skiet in hitte, so hou by die koel saaitye en pluk betyds. Dieselfde botaniese familie (Amaranthaceae) as snybeet en beet, so die wisselbouréël behandel al drie as een familie — moenie een ná 'n ander in dieselfde bedding plant nie.

key: Cool-weather Brassica root — direct-sow only and thin early so the roots can swell. Same botanical family as cabbage, kale and broccoli, so don't plan turnips straight after (or before) another brassica in the same bed. Young leaves are a traditional edible green — pick sparingly; the yield figure covers roots only.
english: Cool-weather Brassica root — direct-sow only and thin early so the roots can swell. Same botanical family as cabbage, kale and broccoli, so don't plan turnips straight after (or before) another brassica in the same bed. Young leaves are a traditional edible green — pick sparingly; the yield figure covers roots only.
draft: Koelweer-Brassica-wortelgewas — saai slegs direk en dun vroeg uit sodat die wortels kan swel. Dieselfde botaniese familie as kool, boerkool en broccoli, so moenie rape direk ná (of voor) 'n ander koolgewas in dieselfde bedding beplan nie. Jong blare is 'n tradisionele eetbare groente — pluk spaarsamig; die opbrengsyfer dek slegs die wortels.

key: DAFF: leaves picked about every two weeks once harvesting starts, continuing until frost ends the crop.
english: DAFF: leaves picked about every two weeks once harvesting starts, continuing until frost ends the crop.
draft: DAFF: blare word ongeveer elke twee weke gepluk sodra die oes begin, en dit gaan voort totdat ryp die gewas beëindig.

key: A cole crop like cabbage and broccoli — same rotation family, so avoid following one straight after another in the same bed. DAFF states cauliflower survives to about 0°C once established, so it is not flagged frost-tender here, but young transplants still want protection from a hard frost snap.
english: A cole crop like cabbage and broccoli — same rotation family, so avoid following one straight after another in the same bed. DAFF states cauliflower survives to about 0°C once established, so it is not flagged frost-tender here, but young transplants still want protection from a hard frost snap.
draft: 'n Koolgewas soos kool en broccoli — dieselfde wisselboufamilie, so vermy om een direk ná 'n ander in dieselfde bedding te plant. DAFF sê blomkool oorleef tot ongeveer 0°C sodra dit gevestig is, so dit word nie hier as rypgevoelig gemerk nie, maar jong oorplantings moet steeds teen 'n skielike harde ryp beskerm word.

key: A drought-tolerant grain crop, more heat- and dry-tolerant than maize. A December sowing is left off this catalog's planner because the resulting May harvest would run into frost — still workable with local frost protection, just not auto-scheduled here. No named SA cultivars were found.
english: A drought-tolerant grain crop, more heat- and dry-tolerant than maize. A December sowing is left off this catalog's planner because the resulting May harvest would run into frost — still workable with local frost protection, just not auto-scheduled here. No named SA cultivars were found.
draft: 'n Droogtebestande graangewas, meer hitte- en droogtebestand as mielies. 'n Desembersaai word uit hierdie katalogus se beplanner gelaat omdat die gevolglike Mei-oes in die ryp sou inloop — steeds werkbaar met plaaslike rypbeskerming, net nie hier outomaties geskeduleer nie. Geen benoemde SA-kultivars is gevind nie.

key: A nitrogen-fixing legume grain crop grown for dry beans, not green pods. DAFF never states a frost sensitivity for soybean, so it is not flagged frost-tender here — but it is a warm-season crop and these sow months are already timed for that.
english: A nitrogen-fixing legume grain crop grown for dry beans, not green pods. DAFF never states a frost sensitivity for soybean, so it is not flagged frost-tender here — but it is a warm-season crop and these sow months are already timed for that.
draft: 'n Stikstofbindende peulgewas wat vir droë bone gekweek word, nie vir groen peule nie. DAFF noem nooit 'n rypgevoeligheid vir sojabone nie, so dit word nie hier as rypgevoelig gemerk nie — maar dit is 'n warmseisoengewas en hierdie saaimaande is reeds daarvoor getyd.

key: Solanaceae family, same as tomatoes, peppers, chilli and potato — keep this rotation family together when planning beds. Frost-tender: raise as transplants and set out only once frost risk has passed.
english: Solanaceae family, same as tomatoes, peppers, chilli and potato — keep this rotation family together when planning beds. Frost-tender: raise as transplants and set out only once frost risk has passed.
draft: Solanaceae-familie, dieselfde as tamaties, soetrissies, brandrissies en aartappel — hou hierdie wisselboufamilie bymekaar wanneer jy beddings beplan. Rypgevoelig: kweek as oorplantings en plant eers uit sodra die rypgevaar verby is.

key: Cucurbitaceae family, same as pumpkin, butternut, cucumber and watermelon — avoid repeating this family in the same bed. Frost-tender vine crop; no Western Cape sowing calendar was found even though it is a known WC crop, so treat that as a local-confirmation item.
english: Cucurbitaceae family, same as pumpkin, butternut, cucumber and watermelon — avoid repeating this family in the same bed. Frost-tender vine crop; no Western Cape sowing calendar was found even though it is a known WC crop, so treat that as a local-confirmation item.
draft: Cucurbitaceae-familie, dieselfde as pampoen, botterskorsie, komkommer en waatlemoen — vermy om hierdie familie in dieselfde bedding te herhaal. Rypgevoelige rankgewas; geen Wes-Kaapse saaikalender is gevind nie, al is dit 'n bekende WK-gewas, so beskou dit as iets om plaaslik te bevestig.

key: A fast-cropping Cucurbitaceae vine picked young and often — same rotation family as pumpkin, gem-squash, cucumber and watermelon. Frost-tender; no Western Cape calendar sourced.
english: A fast-cropping Cucurbitaceae vine picked young and often — same rotation family as pumpkin, gem-squash, cucumber and watermelon. Frost-tender; no Western Cape calendar sourced.
draft: 'n Vinnigdraende Cucurbitaceae-rank wat jonk en dikwels gepluk word — dieselfde wisselboufamilie as pampoen, gem-squash, komkommer en waatlemoen. Rypgevoelig; geen Wes-Kaapse kalender is uit bronne verkry nie.

key: Cucurbitaceae melon vine. A January sowing is left off this catalog's planner because the resulting harvest would run into frost — still workable with local frost protection, just not auto-scheduled here.
english: Cucurbitaceae melon vine. A January sowing is left off this catalog's planner because the resulting harvest would run into frost — still workable with local frost protection, just not auto-scheduled here.
draft: Cucurbitaceae-spanspekrank. 'n Januariesaai word uit hierdie katalogus se beplanner gelaat omdat die gevolglike oes in die ryp sou inloop — steeds werkbaar met plaaslike rypbeskerming, net nie hier outomaties geskeduleer nie.

key: Grown and eaten as a fresh vegetable, unlike field maize — the dossier's own food-group is fruiting vegetable, not staple grain, so it is kept there rather than lumped with maize despite the shared species. Tender to frost like maize.
english: Grown and eaten as a fresh vegetable, unlike field maize — the dossier's own food-group is fruiting vegetable, not staple grain, so it is kept there rather than lumped with maize despite the shared species. Tender to frost like maize.
draft: Word as 'n vars groente gekweek en geëet, anders as veldmielies — die dossier se eie voedselgroep is vrugtegroente, nie stapelgraan nie, so dit word daar gehou eerder as om saam met mielies gegroepeer te word, al is dit dieselfde spesie. Rypgevoelig soos mielies.

key: An indigenous nitrogen-fixing legume grown for its underground dry seed pods (a groundnut relative, not a true bean). The yield figure is dry seed, the low end of genotype averages across seven South African trial sites. A December sowing is left off this catalog's planner because the resulting harvest would run into frost.
english: An indigenous nitrogen-fixing legume grown for its underground dry seed pods (a groundnut relative, not a true bean). The yield figure is dry seed, the low end of genotype averages across seven South African trial sites. A December sowing is left off this catalog's planner because the resulting harvest would run into frost.
draft: 'n Inheemse stikstofbindende peulgewas wat gekweek word vir sy ondergrondse droë saadpeule ('n familielid van die grondboontjie, nie 'n ware boontjie nie). Die opbrengsyfer is droë saad, die lae kant van genotipe-gemiddeldes oor sewe Suid-Afrikaanse proefterreine. 'n Desembersaai word uit hierdie katalogus se beplanner gelaat omdat die gevolglike oes in die ryp sou inloop.

key: An oilseed grain crop grown for dry seed. Frost sensitivity is taken from ECOCROP (DAFF's own guide does not mention frost), and only a November sowing is auto-scheduled here — December and January sowings are left off this catalog's planner because their harvest would run into frost. No named SA cultivars were found.
english: An oilseed grain crop grown for dry seed. Frost sensitivity is taken from ECOCROP (DAFF's own guide does not mention frost), and only a November sowing is auto-scheduled here — December and January sowings are left off this catalog's planner because their harvest would run into frost. No named SA cultivars were found.
draft: 'n Oliesaadgewas wat vir droë saad gekweek word. Rypgevoeligheid is uit ECOCROP geneem (DAFF se eie gids noem nie ryp nie), en slegs 'n Novembersaai word hier outomaties geskeduleer — Desember- en Januariesaaie word uit hierdie katalogus se beplanner gelaat omdat hul oes in die ryp sou inloop. Geen benoemde SA-kultivars is gevind nie.

key: An indigenous leafy green (Solanum retroflexum, umsobo/nightshade) grown for its leaves, picked young — the ripe berries of some related Solanum species are toxic, so only follow a trusted local source for which parts are eaten. DAFF: sensitive to frost. No South African cultivars or yield figures were found, so it stays manual.
english: An indigenous leafy green (Solanum retroflexum, umsobo/nightshade) grown for its leaves, picked young — the ripe berries of some related Solanum species are toxic, so only follow a trusted local source for which parts are eaten. DAFF: sensitive to frost. No South African cultivars or yield figures were found, so it stays manual.
draft: 'n Inheemse blaargroente (Solanum retroflexum, umsobo/nightshade) wat vir sy blare gekweek en jonk gepluk word — die ryp bessies van sommige verwante Solanum-spesies is giftig, so volg slegs 'n betroubare plaaslike bron oor watter dele geëet word. DAFF: gevoelig vir ryp. Geen Suid-Afrikaanse kultivars of opbrengsyfers is gevind nie, so dit bly handmatig.

key: A fast-growing biomass/soil-conditioning and grazing cover crop grown to full flowering, not for a food harvest — not counted in kitchen harvest totals. Same botanical family as radish and cabbage, so plan rotation accordingly. Not frost-tender itself, but is killed by the first hard frost or by herbicide, which is the usual way it is terminated.
english: A fast-growing biomass/soil-conditioning and grazing cover crop grown to full flowering, not for a food harvest — not counted in kitchen harvest totals. Same botanical family as radish and cabbage, so plan rotation accordingly. Not frost-tender itself, but is killed by the first hard frost or by herbicide, which is the usual way it is terminated.
draft: 'n Vinniggroeiende dekgewas vir biomassa/grondverbetering en weiding wat tot volle blom gekweek word, nie vir 'n voedseloes nie — dit word nie by die kombuis se oestotale getel nie. Dieselfde botaniese familie as radys en kool, so beplan wisselbou dienooreenkomstig. Self nie rypgevoelig nie, maar word deur die eerste harde ryp of deur onkruiddoder doodgemaak, wat die gewone manier is waarop dit beëindig word.

key: Quantities stay in their recorded units. Bags, crates, eggs, items and other counts are never converted to kilograms. Names are kept as recorded; differently named crops are not automatically merged.
english: Quantities stay in their recorded units. Bags, crates, eggs, items and other counts are never converted to kilograms. Names are kept as recorded; differently named crops are not automatically merged.
draft: Hoeveelhede bly in hul aangetekende eenhede. Sakke, kratte, eiers, stuks en ander tellings word nooit na kilogram omgeskakel nie. Name word gehou soos aangeteken; gewasse met verskillende name word nie outomaties saamgevoeg nie.

key: {n} local invoices are currently marked unpaid. They do not enter money received.
english: {n} local invoices are currently marked unpaid. They do not enter money received.
draft: {n} plaaslike fakture is tans as onbetaal gemerk. Hulle word nie by geld ontvang ingesluit nie.

key: Check missing costs, unpaid invoices and supporting slips before sharing the report. Untagged costs are never allocated to crop profit.
english: Check missing costs, unpaid invoices and supporting slips before sharing the report. Untagged costs are never allocated to crop profit.
draft: Gaan ontbrekende koste, onbetaalde fakture en stawende strokies na voordat jy die verslag deel. Koste sonder etikette word nooit aan gewaswins toegeken nie.

key: Follow what happened. A buyer paid for produce. The owner added some of their own money. The farm borrowed money. All three can put money in the tin, but they are different events. Write the reason beside each amount. When the owner takes money home, record that too. Do not hide it among packaging or transport. The farm and household both matter. Clear records help you see how they support each other.
english: Follow what happened. A buyer paid for produce. The owner added some of their own money. The farm borrowed money. All three can put money in the tin, but they are different events. Write the reason beside each amount. When the owner takes money home, record that too. Do not hide it among packaging or transport. The farm and household both matter. Clear records help you see how they support each other.
draft: Volg wat gebeur het. 'n Koper het vir produkte betaal. Die eienaar het van hul eie geld bygesit. Die plaas het geld geleen. Al drie kan geld in die blik sit, maar dit is verskillende gebeurtenisse. Skryf die rede langs elke bedrag. Wanneer die eienaar geld huis toe neem, teken dit ook aan. Moenie dit tussen verpakking of vervoer wegsteek nie. Die plaas en die huishouding maak albei saak. Duidelike rekords help jou sien hoe hulle mekaar ondersteun.

key: Give each record a date and a clear reason. Keep the receipt, invoice or another useful reference. After saving, open the entry again and compare it with the source. Check the amount and the unit. A kilogram and a bunch are different. If evidence is missing, write what is unknown. Do not use zero to mean ‘I do not know’. Keep a note of a correction so you can explain it later.
english: Give each record a date and a clear reason. Keep the receipt, invoice or another useful reference. After saving, open the entry again and compare it with the source. Check the amount and the unit. A kilogram and a bunch are different. If evidence is missing, write what is unknown. Do not use zero to mean ‘I do not know’. Keep a note of a correction so you can explain it later.
draft: Gee elke rekord 'n datum en 'n duidelike rede. Hou die kwitansie, faktuur of 'n ander nuttige verwysing. Maak die inskrywing ná die stoor weer oop en vergelyk dit met die bron. As jy nog nie 'n verskil kan verduidelik nie, sê so. Moenie 'n geraaide inskrywing byvoeg net om die totale te laat klop nie.

key: Start with a product and a period. A direct cost belongs to that product. A shared cost serves more than one product. Use a record of how it was used to divide it, and explain your choice. Divide the cost; do not copy the whole bill into both crops. Keep the family's work hours visible too. No wage paid does not mean no work done. An amount used to value that time is different from cash paid out.

key: A budget is a plan with reasons behind the numbers. Name the activity and the period. Show what you expect to sell and what you expect to use. Keep shared bills once in the farm total.
